name: week
title: Operations this week
subtitle: One company. All amounts in the configured currency, excluding tax.

sections.title: Orders needing attention
sections.sql: select code,kind,partner,status,due_date::text,remaining_value from v_orders where status in ('open','draft') order by due_date

sections.title: Stock commitments
sections.sql: select code,name,location,on_hand,committed,incoming,on_hand-committed as available from v_stock order by code,location

sections.title: Jobs
sections.sql: select code,name,status,budget,cost,budget_left,margin from v_jobs order by code

sections.title: Imported ledger balances
sections.note: Record snapshots, not bank balances or tax calculations.
sections.sql: select code,kind,due_date::text,total,paid,total-paid as outstanding,ledger_ref from invoices where total>paid order by due_date

sections.title: Supplier commitments
sections.sql: select code,partner,due_date::text,remaining_value from v_orders where kind='purchase' and status='open' order by due_date
